text:
alex.k: raising an escal for acct acme-inc — their /embeddings endpoint is showing tail-latency spikes since yesterday evening. Reports p90 ~ 300ms -> p99 > 2s, intermittent 400s for some requests. attaching initial findings.

maria.r: can you paste the request ids and route config? is this hosted or Dedicated?

alex.k: hosted (us-west1). Model = text-embed-3-small (expected dim 1536). They run mixed clients; some clients still send 1024-d vectors (old SDK) — that explains occasional 400 dimension_mismatch errors. Main problem: tail latency spikes affecting many small requests. Request ids: req_1790001001 req_1790001122 req_1790001178

samir.p: do we have batching on that route? what's max_batch_size and batching_window_ms? dynamic batching can create huge variability if one client sends a big bulk.

alex.k: found route config: 
```
route: /v1/embeddings
model: text-embed-3-small
batching: { "enabled": true, "max_batch_size": 2048, "batching_window_ms": 20, "dynamic_batching": true }
```

alex.k: logs excerpt (sanitized):
```
{"req_id":"req_1790001122","batch_size":3,"queued_ms":18,"inference_ms":190,"total_ms":225}
{"req_id":"req_1790001178","batch_size":400,"queued_ms":2100,"inference_ms":320,"total_ms":2530}
{"req_id":"req_1790001001","error":"dimension_mismatch","expected":1536,"got":1024}
```

ingrid.s: oof. Large max_batch_size + dynamic batching -> when a client fires a big burst it monopolizes the batching window and causes other small requests to wait. The dimension_mismatch means some clients are still on old SDK.

maria.r: suggested mitigations (quick):
- lower max_batch_size for that route
- enable per-client batching buckets / sharding (route-level client affinity)
- reduce batching_window_ms to lower queuing latency
- validate embedding dims early and return 400 before entering batch

samir.p: agree. Quick roll idea: set max_batch_size=64, batching_window_ms=5, and set dynamic_batching=false for predictable latency. Do a 5% canary first. Also add a metric for "large_batch_count" (batch_size > 128) and alert if it spikes.

deploy-bot: roll started: route /v1/embeddings config update by samir.p — canary 5%

alex.k: i'll contact the customer, ask them to upgrade SDK and to avoid firing huge bulk jobs against the shared endpoint. i'll share a repro script.

alex.k: repro notes (quick):
```
# single-threaded small requests to establish baseline
for i in range(0,1000):
  POST /v1/embeddings body=[small_text]
# then concurrently fire a large bulk call (1000 vectors) to force a large batch
# observe queued_ms and total_ms in our logs for interleaved requests
```

maria.r: operational support checklist to attach to the ticket:
- collect req ids (done)
- collect per-request batch_size + queued_ms + inference_ms
- check model fallback logs (did we re-route to older variant?)
- check X-Client-SDK header / client version per req
- verify if rate-limiting was hit or if a single client monopolized traffic

ingrid.s: opening escalation INC-2026-238 P2, linking customer, assigning alex.k as owner. scheduling 2h follow-up.

samir.p: monitoring actions: add temporary alert p99_latency(/v1/embeddings) > 1s, add metric for batch_size distribution and count of batches >128. If canary looks good, promote config change.

alex.k: will update customer and post back here after canary completes. Thanks for the quick triage team. :thumbsup:
